Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

Type: Direct Subsidy

Benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments directly deposited into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

How to Apply: Register on PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) with Aadhaar and e-KYC or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).

Deadline: Continuous enrolment open throughout the financial year.

Helpline: 1800-11-5526

Eligibility:

  • All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names
  • Subject to institutional landholder exclusion criteria
  • Mandatory Aadhaar-bank account seeding

Documents:

  • Aadhaar Card
  • Land Ownership Records (Khasra/Khatauni copy)
  • Active Bank Account Details with IFSC

Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Crop Loan with Interest Subvention

Type: Subsidized Credit

Benefits: Short-term credit limit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 7% basic interest rate, reduced to 4% effective interest upon prompt repayment (3% Prompt Repayment Incentive by Central Govt).

How to Apply: Submit one-page simplified KCC form at nearest Commercial Bank, RRB, or District Central Cooperative Bank branch.

Deadline: Open year-round; credit limit validity is 5 years with annual renewal.

Helpline: 1800-180-1551

Eligibility:

  • Owner cultivators (individuals / joint borrowers)
  • Tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers
  • SHGs and Joint Liability Groups of farmers

Documents:

  • Filled KCC Application Form
  • Identity and Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
  • Land records certificate (Khasra/Khatauni)
